findings.issue: Battery S5-derived-counts fails on this line. The cause is a checker limit, not a wrong claim: 'its two sidecar files under runtime/database/' is a true count (skill-graph.sqlite-shm and skill-graph.sqlite-wal exist there), but check_derived_readme_counts.py cannot derive it, because the folder holds other files too. The line predates the branch (last README change d68e7fdf888, no diff since base 21c4b325b5a). It entered the battery because the recompiled skill-graph.json is in scope. The file itself is not a scope file. Naming the two sidecars removes the count and clears the battery. An allow-count entry in a readme-check block would also work.

findings.issue: The newest root release notes do not describe the capabilities this scope adds, which the lens requires. The Deep Loop section never names --depth-mode=expansive, --extend=N or --extend-minutes, the review minIterations floor or custom review dimensions. The root README section does describe them (README.md lines 253-255). S6-release-coverage passed only because it matches skill ids such as 'deep review', not capabilities. The v4.1.0.0 tag is not an ancestor of HEAD, so that release shipped without this work. These capabilities need an entry in the next root release, or in v4.1.0.0 if the owner republishes it. This repeats run 12's C-1, handed off to the operator as the release owner's call, and spec.md line 93 puts release notes out of this packet's scope.
